_meta.timingMethod: Video003 dung timestamp THAT tu Whisper alignment (khong phai co giai ty le nhu Video002) - moi beat co realBeatStart/realBeatEnd chinh xac, khong cong don sai so. 3 file audio noi lien tuc, KHONG co artificial gap (break da co san trong audio qua SSML). Transition: CUT (gag/number), WIPE (bridge, huong ngau nhien), DISSOLVE (con lai + luon dung o ranh gioi box). Moi transition co jitter +/-1 frame de tranh nhip cat deu tam tap nhu may.
_meta.editorialNote: Video003: motion/idle dung chung logic voi Video002 (role-aware, khong 1 cong thuc). textOverlay = trich dan NGUON that tu script (9 beat co nguon). chartOverlay = pie chart voi PHAN TRAM THAT cong bo trong script (khong phai minh hoa uoc luong nhu Video002). boxTitleCards = 8 o mau + Bombay, font viet tay, dung vi tri scaledStart cua shot dau tien trong box.
